title: Cushman & Wakefield Appoints Gareth Tsang as Partner Retail Leasing
summary: Cushman & Wakefield Appoints Gareth Tsang as Partner Retail Leasing Netherlands
body_markdown:
Gareth Tsang, Partner Retail Leasing Netherlands


[AMSTERDAM](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/netherlands/offices/amsterdam) , 1 September 2026 –


Cushman & Wakefield has appointed[Gareth Tsang](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/netherlands/people/gareth-tsang) as Partner,[Retail](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/netherlands/industries/retail) Leasing Netherlands, effective 1 September 2026. In this role, Tsang will work alongside the retail team to further shape the growth and development of Cushman & Wakefield's retail leasing operations. His appointment strengthens the firm's position in the Dutch retail market and expands its service offering to a broad range of clients across the retail sector.


Tsang brings extensive experience across the Dutch and international retail real estate market, having advised property owners, investors, and retailers on leasing, expansion strategies, and positioning throughout his career. He has also built a strong national and international network within the retail sector. His expertise in leasing, high streets, shopping centres, and tenant representation aligns with Cushman & Wakefield's ambition to support clients in an ever-evolving retail market, and will make a significant contribution to the continued growth of the Retail & Leisure practice.


[Michiel Boonen](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/netherlands/people/michiel-boonen) , Head of Retail Netherlands at Cushman & Wakefield, said:


“We are delighted to welcome Gareth to the team. His appointment adds further seniority to our retail leasing practice and strengthens our ability to provide clients with the highest level of advice. Bringing Gareth on board is a perfect fit with our ambition to be the leading retail advisor in the Netherlands."
